Skill 更像是一个给 Agent 用的说明书，而且只需要说那些模型不知道的部分。

至于执行，就是工具（脚本、cli、app等等）去做的，是给模型直接调用的。

换句话说，模型不知道怎么用（或者不能高效使用）特定的工具或者执行特定的流程，而 Skill 就是弥补这个差距的存在。

quoted_tweet.author: Riley Brown
quoted_tweet.text:
Hot take: You should learn the basics of video editing...

AI is about to get really good at Davinci, Premiere, After Effects, and more. 

If you have no experience in the timeline, that will be equivalent to vibe coding with no coding experience. The timeline is the codebase.

And... with AI, you can learn these platforms so quickly. When you get stuck just ask AI what to do. 

And you only need to know the basics.

I'd start here w/ davinci or premiere
- How the timeline works
- Sequences and nested sequences
- How audio tracks and mixing works
- How keyframes and animations work
- How to cut, trim, and pace your videos
- How to color grade videos 
- How to layer B-roll, text, and graphics
- How effects, transitions, and masks work
- How to frame, crop, and guide the viewer’s attention
